profile.name: Frédéric Crousaz
profile.headline: Event Officer / Coordinateur d'événements & opérations
profile.summary: Professionnel de la gestion opérationnelle d'événements avec cinq années d'expérience dans l'organisation de grandes conférences internationales, la mise en place des inscriptions et la conclusion de contrats fournisseurs jusqu'à la livraison sur site. Expérience auprès d'organisations internationales (IUCN, CICR, Swiss-African Business Circle). Bonne connaissance de la gestion des plates-formes d'inscription, du suivi des budgets, de la coordination des sponsors, exposants et lieux, et du suivi d'un programme à jour. Disponible pour les déplacements sur site.

jobs.title: Event & Project Manager (100%)
jobs.description: Location: Mostly remote, Rotkreuz, Zurich, Biel or Geneva Start: immediately or by arrangement Who are we? nyou ag is a family-run small business specialising in automotive & mobility for 35 years. We operate in the fields of public relations, media & communication, PR marketing as well as event management. Our core activities include: managing and creating content for various communication channels (social media, media websites, brochures, flyers), writing, translating and publishing press releases and social media content, as well as designing, planning, coordinating and executing press events, customer events, press trips and media conferences, complemented by strategic communication planning and consulting.   Your tasks In this varied and exciting position, you will support our team in planning, coordinating and implementing media activities and events. You will take responsibility in event planning and work closely with internal and external partners. You will coordinate projects from A to Z and ensure everything runs smoothly on site. Your tasks include in particular: Event management: Independent conception, planning and operational implementation of press events, trade fairs, customer events and press trips. Project coordination: Interface function between clients, partners, locations and service providers. On event management: Leading and supervising events on site (Switzerland & partly abroad).   Your profile Completed training or studies in event management, communication, PR, media, journalism, marketing You bring solid experience in planning and executing events and are used to managing projects independently. Native German or French speaker with confident expression; very good knowledge of the other language (DE/FR) Very good English skills, Italian an advantage Strong organisational skills and the ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously Independent, structured and reliable working style with a high standard of quality Proactive, team-oriented personality who enjoys taking responsibility Confident handling of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Experience with CMS systems and newsletter tools (e.g. Mailchimp) an advantage Technical affinity and enthusiasm for digital tools and media analysis   We offer A varied field of activity with exciting projects and eventsFlexible working throughout Switzerland (remote); workspaces available in the Zurich or Zug area on requestIndependent work in a motivated, small teamRoom for your own ideas, creativity and development   We look forward to receiving your complete application documents.

jobs.title: Event Manager, 80-100%
jobs.description: The HSO School of Business and Computer Science, with eleven locations and over 4500 students, is one of the largest private educational providers in Switzerland. It is a subsidiary of the Vantage Education Group. Event Manager, 80-100% To strengthen our event team, we are looking for an open and organised personality from 1 February 2026 or by arrangement. In this role, you will be jointly responsible for organising and executing various events at HSO. Your tasks: Planning and execution of study trips, student events, internal events, graduation ceremonies and open days Development of new concept ideas for events as well as checking their feasibility and launching Searching for and coordinating suppliers, venues and advertising opportunities Assisting with budget allocation, monitoring expenses and maintaining budget records Creating flyers, posters, videos, photos and digital media related to the planned events Coordination with suppliers, sponsors and partners Contact person at events and coordination of the setup and dismantling of event rooms Managing registrations and providing information to external partners Your profile: At least 2 years of experience in event management, tourism or hospitality Willingness to participate in all events and act as a contact person Very good German and English skills, both spoken and written Organisational talent and ability to prioritise tasks Interest in the Swiss education landscape, knowledge of the education sector is an advantage Professional and confident demeanour Willingness to work at events in the evenings or over several days Category B driving licence About you: You have an open, enthusiastic personality with an analytical mindset You convince through entrepreneurial thinking and quality awareness You enjoy interacting with people What we offer you: Thorough introduction to your new interesting role Flexible working hours model Modern infrastructure with free coffee and fruit Up to 90% contribution to training and further education within the Group Five weeks' holiday and a day off on your birthday Attractive long-service gifts Cool staff events SBB half-fare travelcard Are you excited about our offer? Then upload your complete application today on our job portal . We look forward to your application and will get back to you! If you have any questions, please contact Fabienne Troller, HR Manager, Tel. 058 680 35 21, www.vantage.ch.

jobs.title: Event Manager (m/f/d) 60%
jobs.description: Cyber risks are among the greatest challenges for the financial sector today. Attacks are becoming more targeted, and their impacts more far-reaching: they can significantly affect the stability and reputation of the Swiss and Liechtenstein financial centres. For this reason, the Swiss FS-CSC association was founded in April 2022 as a public-private partnership. Its aims are, on the one hand, to strengthen the resilience of the financial sector against cyber risks and, on the other, to establish a joint structure for information exchange and crisis management. Would you like to bring together experts from the financial world, cybersecurity, and politics through the association's events and thus contribute to the cyber resilience of the Swiss and Liechtenstein financial centres? Then an exciting role with plenty of personal responsibility awaits you at our young, dynamic association, where organisational talent, initiative, and a good dose of improvisational skill are required. Event Manager (m/f/d) 60% As an event manager, you bring together the key players from the financial world, cybersecurity, and politics through diverse events, thereby actively contributing to strengthening the cyber resilience of the Swiss financial centre. Requirements You have solid experience in event management and know what it takes to successfully plan and execute events. A relevant further education, for example in event management, communication, project management, or executive assistance, ideally complements your practical experience. You are an organisational talent, work proactively, and successfully implement ideas with your structured and solution-oriented approach. You think ahead, recognise challenges early, and find pragmatic solutions even when there is no plan ready for every situation. Even when things get hectic, you keep an overview thanks to your resilience and composure and set the right priorities. You are confident in stakeholder management and maintain a professional and appreciative relationship with speakers, partners, and service providers. You communicate fluently in German and confidently in English. Knowledge of French is a welcome plus, especially for events in Western Switzerland. You are proficient and purposeful in using Microsoft 365, digital tools, and AI applications to make your workday efficient. You enjoy travelling and have the necessary flexibility to accompany events on site, which may also include occasional overnight stays. Responsibilities You plan, organise, and execute webinars, roundtables, and partner events from A to Z, always keeping a smooth process in focus. You are also responsible for communication planning, ensuring that all parties have the relevant information at the right time. You are the central contact point for our participants and ensure that speakers, partners, and guests feel well cared for. When coordinating venues, technology, catering, and external service providers, you ensure everything runs smoothly without losing sight of quality, deadlines, and budget. You organise merchandise and event materials, keeping an eye on the small details behind the scenes that make an event successful. At our key events, especially the cyber exercises and the general meeting, you support the responsible person in preparation and execution and actively contribute. You also prepare speaker briefings, presentations, and event documents, creating ideal conditions for the optimal preparation of all involved. After the event, you take care of follow-up, evaluate experiences, and use the insights gained to make future events even more successful. Offer You can expect a modern, dynamic working environment where your ideas are valued and you can actively help shape things. You take on a varied and responsible role with short decision-making paths and plenty of room for initiative. You actively shape the development of a young association that connects key players as a public-private partnership and strengthens the cyber resilience of the Swiss and Liechtenstein financial centres. Your workplace is in Basel, with the possibility of home office and occasional assignments in Zurich and Bern. You benefit from contemporary working conditions, attractive fringe benefits, and diverse opportunities to develop professionally and build valuable contacts. Have we piqued your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete written application or an informal initial call at the number: +41 79 390 78 44. Apply
